scope: Internal app embedding of 4 selected gentle CoMiGo bleeps only. Not a bulk import.
creator: Cosmo Myzrail Gorynych
processing: ffmpeg decode/resample to mono 48 kHz; trim leading/trailing silence at -60 dBFS relative to peak; DC removal; linear 12 ms fade-in / 45 ms fade-out (scaled in the same 12:45 ratio when the trimmed clip is shorter than 57 ms); peak -16 dBFS (-18 dBFS for idle); PCM16; exact zero first/last samples. No time-stretch or creative layers. Selection used filenames plus numeric duration/HF/clipping checks; no listening.
playback_rules: Each file is a finite one-shot. Use the suggested role only. Apply the suggested per-cue cooldown. Respect mute. Clean up audio when the app is hidden or the mode turns off.

cues.playback: Finite one-shot; one cue per gesture or condition; do not loop. Respect mute and mixer headroom. Stop and disconnect on hide, unmount, mode-off or cancellation; restore existing state. Hidden-app cleanup required.
cues.selection_note: Short mid-low decaying press/bloop; one event; low HF energy; no clipping.
